title: Japanese Culinary Culture
summary: Japanese: miso and ginger, rice, sesame oil.
origins: Japanese cuisine reflects asia geography, trade routes, and home cooking traditions passed through generations.
history: Balance of sweet, sour, salty, spicy, and umami in every bite.
teaching: High heat for wok hei, fish sauce or soy for umami, fresh herbs at the very end.
Soy, ginger, garlic, rice, and a hot wok or large skillet.
Signature pairing: miso and ginger + rice + sesame oil.
